checks_performed.result: 9 candidates grouped evenly across 3 directions (A, B, C).
Candidate artwork is deterministically typeset from only the approved English and Chinese lines. Internal selection-board labels are outside the consumer-facing KV frames.

For every candidate, the complete product-photo region pixel-matches a uniform resize of the supplied source. No retouching, recoloring, warping, label edit, or overlay was applied inside the photo region.
No copy box intersects a product-photo box in any of the 9 candidates.
Visual QA confirms warm off-white, muted terracotta, and charcoal dominate all directions; treatment is quiet, tactile, and nocturnal without blue/neon sleep-ad tropes.
No treatment, insomnia-improvement, efficacy, pill, clinical, or therapeutic imagery/copy appears in the candidate KVs. Background prompts explicitly excluded medical and sleep-claim symbolism.
All candidates reserve a clear Logo zone that is free of product and copy; the exact Logo itself cannot be placed because no Logo asset was supplied.
No website hero, Instagram vertical, or email-header extensions were produced before internal KV selection.
Selection board inspected at original resolution: all 9 frames are present, product is unobscured, typography is readable, and directions are visually distinct.

unresolved_blockers.detail: An internal selection of one code (A1–C3) is required before channel adaptations.
Provide the existing Logo in SVG, PDF, or transparent PNG so it can be reused exactly.
